about: The UI's and the editor's budgets (tools/bench/ui_bench --check; tools/regress.sh perf). Milliseconds: the fastest of the runs' medians (writes and steps: the program's own TIMER; check and Studio: CPU). Measured 2026-11-05 (SPEED-AUDIT, docs/speed-audit-2026-11.md) on an Apple-silicon Mac busy with other lanes — before the speed fixes / after: #12's 41 moves 12.5 / 0.16 ms (form shown 11.5 / 0.11), 800 place writes 1067 / 1.9, 200 caption writes 131 / 1.1, the 200-control resize step 4.0 / 1.0 (its writes 2.0 / 0.66; a real window's frame 29.2 / 10.7), 12 canvases' OnResize 8.5 / 0.39 (a real window's frame 28.7 / 18.8), check of 5,000 lines with 1,000 $DEFINEs 630 / 138, Studio's caret move 11.7 / 2.0, an edit round 372 / 52. The budgets leave room for a busy machine and still catch any of the old costs coming back (a scroll-bar pass per write, a registry scan per read, a search per $DEFINE per line, a re-count of the newlines per span).
